name: The Collector
description: A trader demands six coins for grain in the council’s name.
claim: The village council has ordered every household to pay six coins for one grain this season. I am collecting for the council: pay me six coins and the grain is yours.

evidence.fact: The village ledger sets the usual price of grain at two coins and records no council order about grain prices.

summaries.accepted: {{name}} paid {{price}} coins on a claimed council order, against a two-coin price.
summaries.refusedByEvidence: The ledger records no council order and a two-coin price. The resident refused.
summaries.refusedByTrust: The resident’s trust threshold was not met. The demand was refused without checking the ledger.
